questions.question: What engineering and oilfield services does Kossel provide?
questions.answer: Kossel's capabilities include civil, mechanical and electrical engineering, procurement, pipeline and cable installation, instrumentation, industrial maintenance, inspection, haulage and marine logistics. The services page outlines how design, sourcing, mobilisation and delivery fit together.

questions.question: Can engineering and procurement be coordinated for one project?
questions.answer: Kossel combines engineering, procurement and logistics support. Share your scope, technical specifications, project location and delivery requirements with the team so the appropriate services and materials can be reviewed together.

questions.question: What information should I provide for a project enquiry?
questions.answer: Provide the project scope, drawings or specifications where available, required services or materials, quantities, site location and target schedule. Contact the team by telephone, email or WhatsApp to discuss the requirements and the next steps.

routes.label: Industrial MRO products
routes.title: Industrial MRO Products & Oilfield Supplies | Kossel
routes.description: Source industrial pipes, valves, flanges, fittings, fasteners, pumps and MRO supplies through Kossel's procurement division. Send your specifications for an enquiry.

questions.question: What does MRO mean in industrial procurement?
questions.answer: MRO stands for maintenance, repair and operations. It includes the equipment, replacement parts and consumables used to maintain industrial facilities and support ongoing operations.

questions.question: Which industrial product categories can I enquire about?
questions.answer: Kossel lists pipes, butt weld and forged fittings, ANSI, API 6A and DIN flanges, valves, fasteners and sealing products, electronic components, pumps and chemicals. Availability and suitability need to be confirmed against your project specifications.

questions.question: How do I request the right valves, flanges or pipe fittings?
questions.answer: Send the item description, quantity, dimensions, material grade, pressure rating, applicable standard, delivery location and required date. Include drawings or a bill of materials where available so the team can review the requirements.
